description: This file defines the interface ICountersGrain for a grain that manages multiple counters, with methods to update, reset, retrieve tentative and confirmed states, and confirm events. It is part of the TestGrainInterfaces namespace.

classes.name: ICountersGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that maintains counters indexed by string keys, with methods for adding, resetting, retrieving, and confirming counter states.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Updates the counter for the given key by the specified amount, with an option to wait for confirmation.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all counters to zero, with an option to wait for confirmation.

methods.name: GetTentativeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative value of the counter for a specific key.

methods.name: GetTentativeState
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative values for all counters.

methods.name: GetConfirmedState
methods.description: Retrieves the confirmed values for all counters.
